After a major Texas storm, most property teams check the parking lot, exterior walls, signage, and landscaping first. The roof should be part of that same walk-through.

Even without an active leak, wind and heavy rain can affect drainage areas, perimeter details, flashing, penetrations, and rooftop equipment. Catching a change early gives the property team more time to respond before it becomes an operational problem.

A proactive roof review is simply part of responsible commercial property management.  #CoreFourRoofing #CommercialRoofing #PropertyManagement #StormReadiness #TexasRoofing

A finished roof gets most of the attention, but some of the most important work happens underneath it. The roof deck and underlayment help create the foundation the visible roofing material depends on.

During a roof replacement, the decking should be reviewed for areas that may need attention before the new system is installed. From there, the underlayment and surrounding details need to be handled correctly for the selected roofing material.

Whether the finished roof uses shingles, metal, tile, or another specialty system, quality starts below the surface. Core Four Roofing looks at the full roof assembly—not just what can be seen from the street.

We recently inspected a residential tile roof after a homeowner's last contractor's repairs didn't stop leakage. What we discovered was a complete roofing disaster. While some of the damage was obvious to the untrained eye, our experts uncovered a slew of hidden hazards waiting to cause major interior damage. We found exposed gaps leading directly into the attic, unsecured ventilation, messy mortar repairs, and failed caulk lines. Across the roof, there were unsecured ridge caps, broken stacked caps, and cracked field tiles completely ignored. To make matters worse, poorly pitched gutters were retaining standing water, and leftover construction debris was simply dumped inside the attic space.

Seeing issues like this highlights the true cost of hiring a non-expert. A tile roof is a highly complex, interlocking system, meaning if one piece is compromised or repaired incorrectly, your entire home is at risk.

Fortunately, for this homeowner, the stress ends today. Core Four Roofing is stepping in to overhaul this botched job completely.  We're making it right.

Don't leave your biggest investment to chance. Hire experts with a proven reputation who actually back their work with a real warranty. If you suspect your roof wasn't repaired correctly, reach out to Core Four Roofing today for an inspection you can trust.
